articles.summary: LOS ANGELES, August 15, 2024 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) – AXIL Brands, Inc. (“AXIL,” “we,” “us,” “our,” or the “Company”) (NYSE American: AXIL), an emerging global consumer products company for AXIL® hearing protection and enhancement products and Reviv3® hair and skin care products, today announced financial and operational results for fiscal year 2024.
articles.title: AXIL Brands, Inc. Reports Record Fiscal Year 2024 Financial Results
